changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictestradiology AS SELECT dtr.id, dtr.test_id, dtr.category, dtr.image_duration, dtr.test_instructions, dtr.medical_indications, dtr.turnaround_time_unit, dtr.turnaround_time, dtr.associated_risks FROM public.diagnostic_test_radiology dtr;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestradiology TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestradiology FROM report_user;
